contract.archive_validity_not_retroactive: later archive admission cannot alter a decision evaluated at an earlier T
contract.completed_bars_only: a bar is readable only once its provider close_time has passed; the forming bar is invisible
contract.conflicting_duplicates_fail_closed: a month containing a conflicting duplicate is withheld whole; a partition with a duplicate slot raises
contract.data_time_le_decision_time: every 5m bar used by a decision satisfies bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms
contract.decision_instant: decision_time_ms = close_time of the signal bar (provider field 6, epoch ms)
contract.exact_duplicates: byte-identical duplicate rows collapse deterministically (one kept)
contract.future_mutation_invariance: bars with open_time > decision_time cannot change any feature, reason code or emitted direction
contract.missing_stale_fails_closed: fewer than 30 complete reference observations -> REFERENCE_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE (NO_SIGNAL)
contract.past_eligible_mutation_detectable: mutating a reference bar changes participation_shock/excursion_record
contract.provider_schema_change: a header row (from 2022-01; SOLUSDT 2022-03 excepted) is detected by exact match and skipped
contract.reference_observations: the 30 same 5m-slot daily references satisfy data_time <= decision_time trivially (t - 86400000*j)

no_future_field_admitted: close_time is read only as the bar's own completion anchor, never as a forward observation
